Annotation frame helpers

Source: R/annotation-frames.R
anndata-annotation-frames.Rd

Internal helpers that turn user input into the S4Vectors::DataFrame held in obs and var (ADR 0003). Accepted input is NULL, a named list, a data.frame or a DataFrame. A list may give the index in an obs_names/row_names (or var_names/col_names) element.

Usage

as_annotation_frame(
  anno,
  attr = c("obs", "var"),
  expected = NULL,
  source = c("X", "shape"),
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

warn_names_not_unique(attr, call = rlang::caller_env())

check_names_unique(names, attr, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

anno

The input value.

attr

Either "obs" or "var".

expected

The number of rows required, or NULL to take it from the input.

source

What fixed the length, "X" or "shape", used in the error message.

call

The call reported by conditions.

names

Names of observations or variables.

Details

The row names of the result are the obs_names or var_names. They are character and may contain duplicates and NA. The index name is kept in S4Vectors::metadata() under index_name, and is read from the same place on a DataFrame or from the index_name attribute of a data.frame.
